query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM payroll_items pi
            JOIN payroll_runs pr ON pi.payroll_run_id = pr.id
            WHERE pi.employee_id = $1
              AND pr.company_id = $2
              AND pr.status IN ('processed', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'paid')
              AND pr.period_year = $3
              AND pr.period_month > $4
        ) AS "exists!"
